subject: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: partners@observify.com, alliances@datadog.com, partnerships@grafana.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Hi team —

Thanks for the productive demo yesterday. Observify's OTLP-to-Redwood adapter looks promising and could unlock a co-sell pilot with a mutual customer in our pipeline. Before we lock dates, we need 2 quick things to confirm pilot eligibility and scope: 

1) Data control and retention matrix for the adapter (what fields are persisted, retention defaults, encryption at rest details)
2) A short technical checklist for sampling/headers the adapter preserves (trace/span IDs, sampling.priority, user_id hashing)
3) Preliminary SOW scope (2-week integration + 4-week pilot, target throughput ~200 rps)

Ben and Laura from our integrations team are copied — Ben will run the technical validation and Laura will coordinate commercial terms. 

Could Observify share the matrix and a draft SOW by EOD Monday (PST)? We'll then route for SOC2 evidence and finalize DocuSign.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0119

Redwood Inference — Making inference predictable and economical
From: Observify Solutions <partners@observify.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, alliances@datadog.com, partnerships@grafana.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Hi Naomi / Ben / Laura —

Great to chat — really excited about the potential pilot. Attaching an initial data-retention matrix and draft SOW. Quick notes: 

- By default we retain traces/metrics for 30 days; customer can configure down to 7 days or up to 90 via policy.
- Sensitive fields (user.email, user.phone) are redacted before storage; we also offer an opt-in hashed-uid feature for correlation without storing PII.
- We support OTLP v1.17 and forward trace/span attributes unchanged unless configured for PII redaction.

We have included an ops contact (sre@observify.com) for any ingestion-level tests. If anything in the matrix needs to be hardened for your compliance team, tell us and we'll add the controls.

Attachments: observify-pilot-sow-v1.pdf, data-retention-matrix.xlsx

Cheers,
Maya Ranganathan
Head of Partnerships, Observify
partners@observify.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ranganathan <partners@observify.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. I did a first-pass review and left inline comments in the SOW PDF (attachment stub: see page notes). High-level technical asks before we start test traffic: 

- Can you expose a test endpoint that mirrors production headers (we'll send synthetic traces with sampling.priority variations)?
- Please confirm the adapter preserves trace_id and span_id verbatim (no truncation).
- We need an OTLP ingestion config snippet to match our pilot rig — I'll attach our expected config.

I'll schedule a 60-minute deep-dive with your SRE next Tue. For now I'm attaching otlp-ingestion-config.yaml which includes batching/window params we want to validate.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: otlp-ingestion-config.yaml
From: Grafana Partnerships <partnerships@grafana.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, partners@observify.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Hi all —

Quick note from Grafana side: for any co-marketing/marketplace listing we'll need the final integration manifest and a short security questionnaire filled out. We can accept the standard questionnaire but would prefer a completed copy before the pilot launch.

Also curious about whether Observify will push derived metrics back into Grafana Cloud or only into our customers' stores — that affects the commercial packaging.

Happy to align on timeline once the SOW is finalized.

Thanks,
Ana Silva
Partner PM, Grafana
partnerships@grafana.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: partners@observify.com, partnerships@grafana.com, alliances@datadog.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Thanks, everyone — helpful points. Next steps I propose: 

- Observify to confirm test endpoint + deliver updated SOW with inline answers to Ben's technical checklist by EOD Monday.
- Observify to complete Grafana's security questionnaire (Grafana: we'll share link) and provide any additional marketplace manifest fields needed.
- Redwood will run SOC2 evidence intake in parallel (Vivek, can you pick this up?)
- We aim to start test traffic Wed Jul 7, ramping to target throughput over one week.

Laura: once SOW is final, can you issue the DocuSign SOW with the pilot dates placeholder? Observify: please confirm whether derived metrics are written back to Grafana Cloud or only to customer destinations.

If we can get attachments and the questionnaire returned early next week, we can keep the July 7 target.

Best,
Naomi
From: Maya Ranganathan <partners@observify.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ana Silva <partnerships@grafana.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot eligibility & data-control checklist for Observify telemetry adapter

Naomi / Ben / Ana —

Thanks — confirm we will: 

- Stand up a production-mirror test endpoint by Tue Jun 29 and share creds with Ben's SRE team.
- Update the SOW with Ben's inline answers and return finalized PDF by EOD Monday.
- Fill Grafana's security questionnaire (we expect no blockers) and confirm derived metrics will be optionally pushed to Grafana Cloud; default is customer-only, opt-in for Grafana push.
- Send SOC2 evidence link to Vivek by Monday so Redwood can ingest it.

I'll drop the completed items into the Drive folder and ping the DocuSign link once Laura issues the SOW. Looking forward to the deep-dive next week.

Best regards,
Maya Ranganathan
Head of Partnerships, Observify
partners@observify.com

--
Attachment note: final SOW and retention matrix were updated and reuploaded to the shared Drive folder referenced above.
